name: autoresearch-synthesize decide(emit) → reviewer-autoresearch
description:
ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign autoresearch pack terminal forward edge. Fires when autoresearch-synthesize terminates with decide(action=emit) — the synthesize phase has emitted the structured artifact via emit_autoresearch_artifact. Spawns reviewer-autoresearch, which grades the artifact's structural completeness against the autoresearch-specific checklist.

Reviewer-autoresearch is a SEPARATE persona from reviewer-research because the artifact shape differs (baseline/best/journey/open_opportunities vs actors/integration_points/tasks). The role token follows the reviewer-<category> convention.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.reviewer-autoresearch
on_enter.prompt:
The autoresearch-synthesize at loop $entity.instance emitted an autoresearch artifact via emit_autoresearch_artifact + decide(action=emit). The rendered markdown is at $entity.triple.autoresearch.artifact.path.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result on $entity.instance for the synthesize phase's terminal reason (one-line summary referencing the artifact slug + improvement percentage).

Iteration 2 — `bash cat $entity.triple.autoresearch.artifact.path` to read the full structured artifact. read_loop_result returns only the decide() reason; the structured fields (title, command, baseline_value, best_value, improvement_pct, iterations_*, best_diff_summary, journey, open_opportunities) live in the rendered markdown.

Iteration 3 — apply the autoresearch-specific checklist per reviewer-autoresearch/10-evaluation-contract.md. Substance over format: the artifact is GRADED ON STRUCTURAL COMPLETENESS (every required field present and well-formed), NOT on improvement magnitude. A run that produced 0 kept iterations and a faithful negative-result rollup is APPROVABLE; a run that claims a 50% improvement but has missing journey entries or an unverified best_diff_summary is INSUFFICIENT.

- All required fields present + well-formed + grounded in the per-iteration journal → decide(action="approved", reason="<one-sentence summary: 'autoresearch artifact complete; <iterations_completed> iterations, best=<best_value> vs baseline=<baseline_value> (<improvement_pct>% improvement)'>").
- One or more required fields missing/malformed/ungrounded → decide(action="insufficient", reason="<bullet list of gaps>"). 09-reviewer-rejected-resynthesize.json gates retries (max_iterations=2 — budget already spent on iteration loops; retry re-runs the synthesize-only rollup, NOT the iteration loop).
- decide(action="needs_clarification", reason=...) only when the artifact's intent is structurally malformed (path triple absent, the run state itself is inconsistent — e.g. iterations_completed != length of journey).

metadata.pattern: autoresearch category terminal: synthesize emits structured artifact → reviewer-autoresearch evaluates structural completeness. Approved wakes coordinator (08); insufficient retries synthesize-only (09).
metadata.structural_review_not_substance: Reviewer-autoresearch grades structural completeness of the artifact (every required field present, well-formed, grounded in the journal). It does NOT grade improvement magnitude — that is a property of the surface and the cap, not a quality the reviewer can assess. A negative-result run with a faithful rollup is approvable. This is the autoresearch-specific contract distinguishing it from reviewer-research's substance-grading.
metadata.run_loop_entity_id_threading: ADR-053 Phase 4a: threads run-loop-entity-id (the 6-part run entity id, carried by the synthesize loop from rule 05's $entity.id) to the reviewer so rule 08's agent.run.outcome=success stamp can target the run entity. The autoresearch chain descends through the run-entity-fired rule 05, so its loops carry NO agent.run.entity_id (the run entity has no bare agent.run triple to inherit) — lineage.run-loop-entity-id is the only run anchor available. Without this thread the reviewer carries neither anchor and the stamp subject resolves to a literal token (go-reviewer C1, also the 09 known_gap_orphaned_accumulator_read).
